question_en: A conveyor control has failed and insulation/current tests are available. What should guide the maintenance decision?
options: Determine the fault from field/test results, repair or use OEM/equivalent replacement components, then test and analyze results against specifications.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: D-24.02 requires diagnosis from assessments/tests, OEM/equivalent replacement where needed, post-repair testing, and comparison/analysis of results.
explanation_es: D-24.02 exige diagnóstico mediante evaluaciones/pruebas, reemplazo OEM/equivalente, pruebas posteriores y análisis de resultados.

question_en: A 10 hp electrical load is converted to watts using the official exam formula. What is the result?
A resistive load draws 8 A through 12 Ω. What power is dissipated?
A three-phase motor has been repaired. What should happen before it is returned to normal operation?
options: Conduct post-repair tests and compare results with specifications.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires testing after repair and analysis of maintenance test results.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige pruebas después de la reparación y análisis de resultados.

question_en: Maintenance test results show a change from baseline. What is the correct next approach?
options: Analyze the results and compare them with specifications.
Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires comparison and analysis of maintenance test results.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige comparación y análisis de resultados de mantenimiento.
